verses.original: בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם מ֣וּסַר אָ֑ב וְ֝לֵ֗ץ לֹא־ שָׁמַ֥ע גְּעָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bên ḥā·ḵām mū·sar ’āḇ wə·lêṣ lō- šā·ma‘ gə·‘ā·rāh
verses.literal: A wise son heeds his father’s discipline but a mocker does not listen to rebuke
verses.literalPt: O filho sábio ouve a instrução de seu pai, mas o escarnecedor não escuta a reprovação.

verses.original: מִפְּרִ֣י פִי־ אִ֭ישׁ יֹ֣אכַל ט֑וֹב וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ בֹּגְדִ֣ים חָמָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: mip·pə·rî p̄î- ’îš yō·ḵal ṭō·wḇ wə·ne·p̄eš bō·ḡə·ḏîm ḥā·mās
verses.literal: From the fruit of his lips a man enjoys good things but the desire of the faithless is violence
verses.literalPt: Pelo fruto da sua boca, o homem comerá o bem, mas a alma dos prevaricadores comerá a violência.

verses.original: נֹצֵ֣ר פִּ֭יו שֹׁמֵ֣ר נַפְשׁ֑וֹ פֹּשֵׂ֥ק שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו מְחִתָּה־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: nō·ṣêr pîw šō·mêr nap̄·šōw pō·śêq śə·p̲ā·t̲āyw mə·ḥit·tāh- lōw
verses.literal: He who guards his mouth protects his life but the one who opens his lips invites his own ruin
verses.literalPt: Quem guarda a sua boca conserva a sua vida, mas aquele que abre grandemente os seus lábios será destruído.

verses.original: מִתְאַוָּ֣ה וָ֭אַיִן נַפְשׁ֣וֹ עָצֵ֑ל וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ חָרֻצִ֣ים תְּדֻשָּֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: miṯ·’aw·wāh wā·’a·yin nap̄·šōw ‘ā·ṣêl wə·ne·p̄eš ḥā·ru·ṣîm tə·ḏuš·šān
verses.literal: The slacker . . . craves yet has nothing but the soul of the diligent is fully satisfied
verses.literalPt: A alma do preguiçoso deseja e nada tem; mas a alma dos prudentes será saciada.

verses.original: דְּבַר־ שֶׁ֭קֶר יִשְׂנָ֣א צַדִּ֑יק וְ֝רָשָׁ֗ע יַבְאִ֥ישׁ וְיַחְפִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: də·ḇa·rō·še- še·qer yiś·nā ṣad·dîq wə·rā·šā‘ yaḇ·’îš wə·yaḥ·pîr
verses.literal: The righteous hate falsehood . . . but the wicked bring shame and disgrace
verses.literalPt: O justo aborrece ao que é falso, mas o perverso se faz odioso e se cobre de vergonha.

verses.original: צְ֭דָקָה תִּצֹּ֣ר תָּם־ דָּ֑רֶךְ וְ֝רִשְׁעָ֗ה תְּסַלֵּ֥ף חַטָּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: ṣə·ḏā·qāh tiṣ·ṣōr tām- dā·reḵ wə·riš·‘āh tə·sal·lêp̄ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: Righteousness guards the man of integrity . . . but wickedness undermines the sinner
verses.literalPt: A justiça guarda ao que anda em integridade, mas a perversidade arruína ao pecador.

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ מִ֭תְעַשֵּׁר וְאֵ֣ין כֹּ֑ל מִ֝תְרוֹשֵׁ֗שׁ וְה֣וֹן רָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: yêš miṯ·‘aš·šêr wə·’ên kōl miṯ·rō·wō·šêš wə·hō·wn rāḇ
verses.literal: One pretends to be rich but has nothing . . . another pretends to be poor yet has great wealth
verses.literalPt: Uns se dizem ricos sem ter nada; outros se dizem pobres, sendo mui ricos.

verses.original: כֹּ֣פֶר נֶֽפֶשׁ־ אִ֣ישׁ עָשְׁר֑וֹ וְ֝רָ֗שׁ לֹא־ שָׁמַ֥ע גְּעָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kō·p̄er ne·p̄eš- ’îš ‘ā·šə·rōw wə·rāš lō- šā·ma‘ gə·‘ā·rāh
verses.literal: Riches may ransom a man’s life but a poor man hears no threat
verses.literalPt: O resgate da vida do homem são os seus haveres, mas o pobre não escuta a repreensão.

verses.original: אוֹר־ צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִשְׂמָ֑ח וְנֵ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·wr- ṣad·dî·qîm yiś·māḥ wə·nêr rə·šā·‘îm yiḏ·‘āḵ
verses.literal: The light of the righteous shines brightly but the lamp of the wicked is extinguished
verses.literalPt: A luz dos justos alegra, mas a lâmpada dos perversos se apagará.

verses.original: רַק־ בְּ֭זָדוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן מַצָּ֑ה וְאֶת־ נ֖וֹעָצִ֣ים חָכְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: raq- bə·zā·ḏō·wn yit·tên maṣ·ṣāh wə·’eṯ- nō·w·‘ā·ṣîm ḥāḵ·māh
verses.literal: Arrogance leads only to strife but wisdom is with the well-advised
verses.literalPt: Da soberba provém só a contenda, mas com os bem avisados está a sabedoria.

verses.original: ה֭וֹן מֵהֶ֣בֶל יִמְעָ֑ט וְקֹבֵ֖ץ עַל־ יָ֣ד יַרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hō·wn mê·he·ḇel yim·‘āṭ wə·qō·ḇêṣ ‘al- yāḏ yar·beh
verses.literal: Dishonest wealth will dwindle but what is earned through hard work will be multiplied
verses.literalPt: As riquezas adquiridas às pressas diminuir-se-ão, mas aquele que ajunta pouco a pouco será próspero.

verses.original: תּוֹחֶ֣לֶת מְ֭מֻשָּׁכָה מַחֲלָה־ לֵ֑ב וְעֵ֥ץ חַ֝יִּ֗ים תַּאֲוָ֥ה בָאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·ḥe·leṯ mə·muš·šā·ḵāh ma·ḥă·lāh- lêḇ wə·‘êṣ ḥay·yîm ta·’ă·wāh ḇā·’āh
verses.literal: Hope deferred makes the heart sick but desire fulfilled is a tree of life
verses.literalPt: A esperança prolongada faz adoecer o coração, mas o desejo cumprido é árvore de vida.

verses.original: בָּ֣ז לְ֭דָבָר יֵחָ֣בֶל ל֑וֹ וִירֵ֥א מִ֝צְוָ֗ה ה֣וּא יְשֻׁלָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bāz lə·ḏā·ḇār yê·ḥā·ḇel lōw wî·rê miṣ·wāh hū yə·šul·lām
verses.literal: He who despises instruction will pay the penalty but the one who respects a command . . . will be rewarded
verses.literalPt: Quem despreza a palavra traz sobre si a destruição, mas será recompensado o que teme o mandamento.

verses.original: תּוֹרַ֣ת חָ֭כָם מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים לָ֝ס֗וּר מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·raṯ ḥā·ḵām mə·qō·wr ḥay·yîm lā·sūr mim·mō·qə·šê mā·weṯ
verses.literal: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life turning one from the snares of death
verses.literalPt: O ensino do sábio é fonte de vida, para escapar dos laços da morte.

verses.original: שֵֽׂכֶל־ ט֭וֹב יִתֶּן־ חֵ֑ן וְדֶ֖רֶךְ בֹּגְדִ֣ים אֵיתָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: śê·ḵel- ṭō·wḇ yit·ten- ḥên wə·ḏe·reḵ bō·ḡə·ḏîm ’ê·ṯān
verses.literal: Good understanding wins favor but the way of the faithless is difficult
verses.literalPt: A boa inteligência consegue favor, mas o caminho dos prevaricadores é escabroso.

verses.original: כָּל־ עָ֭רוּם יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה בְדָ֑עַת וּ֝כְסִ֗יל יִפְרֹ֥שׂ אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ‘ā·rūm ya·‘ă·śeh ḇə·ḏā·‘aṯ ū·ḵə·sîl yip̄·rōś ’iw·we·leṯ
verses.literal: Every prudent man acts with knowledge but a fool displays his folly
verses.literalPt: Todo homem prudente procede com conhecimento, mas o tolo ostenta a estultícia.

verses.original: מַלְאָ֣ךְ רָ֭שָׁע יִפֹּ֣ל בְּרָ֑ע וְצִ֖יר אֱמוּנִ֣ים מַרְפֵּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: mal·’āḵ rā·šā‘ yip·pōl bə·rā‘ wə·ṣîr ’ĕ·mū·nîm mar·pê
verses.literal: A wicked messenger falls into trouble but a faithful envoy brings healing
verses.literalPt: O mensageiro perverso faz cair na desgraça, mas o embaixador fiel consegue a cura.

verses.original: רֵ֣ישׁ וְ֭קָלוֹן פּוֹרֵ֣עַ מוּסָ֑ר וְשׁוֹמֵ֖ר תּוֹכַ֣חַת יְכֻבָּֽד׃
verses.transliteration: rêš wə·qā·lō·wn pō·w·rê·a‘ mū·sār wə·šō·w·mêr tō·w·ḵa·ḥaṯ yə·ḵub·bāḏ
verses.literal: Poverty and shame come to him who ignores discipline but whoever heeds correction is honored
verses.literalPt: A pobreza e a afronta virão sobre aquele que despreza a correção, mas o que tem em conta a repreensão será honrado.

verses.original: תַּאֲוָ֣ה נִ֭הְיָה תֶּעֱרַ֣ב לְנָ֑פֶשׁ וְתוֹעֲבַ֥ת כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים ס֣וּר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ta·’ă·wāh nih·yāh ṯe·‘ĕ·raḇ lə·nā·p̄eš wə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ kə·sî·lîm sūr mê·rā‘
verses.literal: Desire fulfilled is sweet to the soul but turning from evil is detestable to fools
verses.literalPt: O desejo realizado deleita a alma, mas apartar-se do mal é abominação para os loucos.

verses.original: הָלוֹךְ אֶת־ חֲכָמִ֣ים וַחֲכָם וְרֹעֶ֖ה כְסִילִ֣ים יֵרֽוֹעַ׃
verses.transliteration: hå̄·lōḵ ’eṯ- ḥă·ḵā·mîm wa·ḥă·ḵå̄m wə·rō·‘eh ḵə·sî·lîm yê·rō·w·a‘
verses.literal: He who walks with the wise will become wise but the companion of fools will be destroyed
verses.literalPt: Quem anda com os sábios será sábio, mas o companheiro dos loucos achar-se-á mal.

verses.original: חַ֭טָּאִים תְּרַדֵּ֣ף רָעָ֑ה וְאֶת־ צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יְשַׁלֶּם־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm tə·rad·dêp̄ rā·‘āh wə·’eṯ- ṣad·dî·qîm yə·šal·lem- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: Disaster pursues sinners but prosperity is the reward of the righteous
verses.literalPt: O mal persegue os pecadores, mas os justos serão recompensados com o bem.

verses.original: ט֗וֹב יַנְחִ֥יל בְּנֵֽי־ בָנִ֑ים וְצָפ֥וּן לַ֝צַּדִּ֗יק חֵ֣יל חוֹטֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ yan·ḥîl bə·nê- ḇā·nîm wə·ṣā·p̄ūn laṣ·ṣad·dîq ḥêl ḥō·w·ṭê
verses.literal: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children but the sinner’s wealth is passed to the righteous
verses.literalPt: O homem de bem deixa uma herança aos filhos de seus filhos, e os bens do pecador estão reservados para o justo.

verses.original: רָב־ אֹ֭כֶל נִ֣יר רָאשִׁ֑ים וְיֵ֥שׁ נִ֝סְפֶּ֗ה בְּלֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: rāḇ- ’ō·ḵel nîr rā·šîm wə·yêš nis·peh bə·lō miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Abundant food is in the fallow ground of the poor but without justice it is swept away
verses.literalPt: Bastante alimento há na lavoura dos pobres, mas há quem se consome pela falta de justiça.

verses.original: חוֹשֵׂ֣ךְ שִׁ֭בְטוֹ שׂוֹנֵ֣א בְנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֹהֲב֗וֹ שִֽׁחֲר֥וֹ מוּסָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḥō·w·śêḵ šib̲·ṭô śō·w·nê ḇə·nōw wə·’ō·hă·ḇōw ši·ḥă·rōw mū·sār
verses.literal: He who spares the rod hates his son but he who loves him disciplines him diligently
verses.literalPt: Aquele que poupa a vara aborrece a seu filho, mas quem o ama diligentemente o corrige.

verses.original: צַדִּ֗יק אֹ֭כֵל לְשֹׂ֣בַע נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּבֶ֖טֶן רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֶּחְסָֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dîq ’ō·ḵêl lə·śō·ḇa‘ nap̄·šōw ū·ḇe·ṭen rə·šā·‘îm teḥ·sār
verses.literal: A righteous man eats to his heart’s content but the stomach of the wicked is empty
verses.literalPt: O justo come até matar a fome, mas o ventre dos perversos terá falta.
